top_themes.label: Trading & orders
top_themes.summary: Users report frequent unwanted notifications and automatic order switches to BSE, causing confusion. Some praise the ease of option selection, but overall experience is mixed.

top_themes.label: Onboarding & demat
top_themes.summary: New users face app crashes during permission stages, preventing account setup. Positive feedback highlights quick demat account creation for experienced users.

top_themes.label: Payments & UPI
top_themes.summary: Users report fraudulent app behavior and difficulty adding funds, raising security concerns. Technical errors persist for some, impacting trust.

actions.title: Reduce Unwanted Notifications
actions.detail: Implement a notification filter to allow users to opt‑in for trade alerts only, and prevent automatic BSE order switches.

actions.title: Fix Permission‑Stage Crashes
actions.detail: Resolve app crashes during permission prompts by updating the launch sequence and adding robust error handling.

actions.title: Enhance Fund Transfer Security
actions.detail: Introduce two‑factor authentication for adding money and audit the transfer process to eliminate fraud claims.
